intro: Remy "Two Times" is a human merchant currently residing in the village of Goldshire. Originally hailing from the Redridge Mountains, he is easily recognized by his peculiar habit of repeating the ends of his sentences. He maintains business interests across Elwynn Forest, trading goods and paying adventurers for raw materials like gold dust.

sections.t: A Merchant with an Odd Quirk
p: Operating out of Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" is an enterprising trader who made his way west from the rugged terrain of the Redridge Mountains. True to his moniker, Remy possesses a distinctive verbal tick: repeating the final words of his sentences, usually twice. Despite his comical speech pattern, he remains a savvy merchant looking to turn a profit amid the growing troubles in Elwynn Forest, readily striking deals with traveling adventurers.

With kobolds overrunning the local gold mines and aggressive murlocs infesting the riverbanks, normal commerce in Elwynn has been heavily disrupted. Remy seizes opportunity where others see disaster, commissioning adventurers to bring him pouchfuls of gold dust gathered from the vermin infesting the mines, as well as keeping tabs on suspicious murloc movements near Crystal Lake.
